reviews.text: Awesome. Awesome app

The best sobriety app. I have used Nomo for years now. When I started my sobriety journey, I knew I needed a way to track it, and just so happened to find my way to the most supportive tracker for it. The support provided, the options for different clocks, and the reinforcement through watching those numbers go up are so constructive in keeping you accountable. If you’re trying to quit literally anything, I cannot recommend this app enough. 5 stars doesn’t do it justice.
Life Saving app. So grateful to have this app to set me free from what tries to enslave me.
so glad an app like this exists. so helpful and keeps you accountable
Great App. This app is helping me be honest and accountable to myself. Thank you!

Idk. I really like how it doesn’t send notifications, the apps that send notifications just make me wanna not log my day into the app. I like how this app just counts the days without making you check in.
Awesome!!. Very easy to follow, I love the circle so it shows you exactly where you’re at
Keeps me going!. This app is so helpful in keeping myself on track and being able to see how far i’ve come. great little pick me up when i’m feeling down. thank you.
Amazing app. Simple & easy to use! No extra hidden fees. You can use it to track your growth with anything.

Simply the best. It's simple, and not the least complicated. If you are quitting a habit you don't want extra or a frustrating app. You can have multiple timers, so if you decide to quit drinking today, and four months from now you quit smoking. You can also name it personally. It's also not loaded down with ads, commercials or buy my subscription. You don't even have to register just use it like a guest tool or the calendar on your phone. Perfect app!

Awesome app. Whenever I’m either having a day when I’m struggling, or grateful that I no longer drink, I love logging on. It’s a reminder that I’m doing the right thing for my family and myself. Love this app.
Thank you.. This app helped me hold it together when I didn’t want to, and helped me build the only habit I’ve ever really needed. Thank you.

Simple, useful, no frills, donation based clearly developed by a like-minded person who gets it.. I’ve used this app for over five solid years of recovery. I know my dates, but I never know my exact months and days and this is a quick way to reference where I am and Recovery and other practice such as a meditation challenge or challenging myself to do a reading every day, etc. I believe they also added some mental health conditions where CBT/ DBT is helpful, so track whatever you want to track. Can be customized for any accomplishment you want to track and if you need to start over a clock, you know you’re not alone. Start it back over at 5 mins, 1 hour, 6 hours, 24 hours, and one day at a time, etc. You got this. Don’t be too hard on yourself.
Motivational!. Such a great app! This has been inspiring on good days and the motivation I need on the tough days! So thankful to have this tool to aid in my sobriety!

7.5 years - Numbers are my anchor. This app gives me keep perspective. Being able to put in the daily time, daily costs, and other life variables is amazing. 

You’re able to see the seconds, minutes, calories, dollars, and moments that are being saved.

The app has changed a ton over seven years. In the beginning it was the simple things: the check ins on the app, the digital chips, and the beep every second or minute or hour, whenever you needed it. 

As strange as it may sound, the details in the app timers are always there to support you. Showing your progress with every decision you make. Stacking days and decisions into huge amazing statistics that matter. That you can be proud of. 

This app has evolved into something pretty incredible. That said, the basic timer’s purpose and function is an irreplaceable piece of the support system. Use it.
Nice App. Helpful keeping track of

No matter how many times I start over, this app remains.. Finding an app that’s actually free and easy to use really makes my circumstance feel a little lighter. I always come back to it when I fall, and I hope this is my last go of it.
Great app. This app is simple to use and keeps me in check for my sobriety.
It just works 👌🏽. Free for the community with no restrictions or fluff.
Simple. Clean. Free.. A+ app that accomplishes what it sets out to do. Thanks so much for this clean and simple method to track my time. Really appreciate it.
Appreciation. Thankful for this app and how it helps keep me accountable by tracking my progress
Highly recommend. The best app I found. You can fully customize everything and it’s free!! Love this app.
Love this app. The fact that it’s free says a lot for the developer. He’s been where we are at!

Phenomenal app with great tools. Not only can you track multiple “clocks” for sobriety, there’s also helpful tools and motivation. I tried multiple of these types of apps, but this one has by far been the best!

Daily encouragement. I check my days sobered several times a week. I’ve come a long way, and just seeing the number is enough to keep me moving forward! There is a lot of good info in here that I go to for help, and I’m so glad you made this app.

Great Companion. Thesis app is so much better ethan many paid apps. Well designed and fun. Its a great Encouragement for me to wake up every day and look at my progress and to keep checking in as the day goes by especially when you're tempted. Your plan shows up.
Great app. I use this every day and it has really helped me.
Oh my how time does fly. One day, or one moment at at time.
Great reminder. ❤️
Life changing tool for sober folk :). Having this app has been a pivotal part of my sober journey.
Love it. This app is great and free! I like its simplicity
Nice app. Was hoping for free widgets. Great effort and idea. I use it everyday. Bummer that yesterday was the first Sunday of the month and the app widget wasn’t free.

We need more self accountability & awareness. This is a great app even the benefits of having therapy percentages cut … great for sober living. Even when you mess up you keep it to remind you of where you would of been
the best sober clock. user friendly and i love the widgets! owner seems like they really care abt the community too which is so cool
Great App. Does what is says and works great and Free!!
Perfect for what I need. This app has been great. It’s like a supportive friend that you can reach out to during a struggle.
Great app to track your success. A great app to track your progress - with a group behind you cheering you all the way! No negatives only positive! 🌻
Free tracker. As many clocks as you want for free. Great :) a lot of other apps make you pay for more than 2
Best. Love it
I love it!. The app is very helpful. I love that it capture days for you and more!
Solid App. I rely on this app, and have for almost 8 years, to keep track of the time I’ve been sober and how long I’ve quit smoking. It’s safe and reliable. Highly recommend.
Perfectly simple.. Thank you, Parker. And for the widgets app.
Excellent!. A great app.
Multiple counters one screen. I like I can have multiple clean time counters on the same screen and also adjust it from counting days/months/years etc. I dig it!
Great app. Love this app. Has been with me for 9+ years and never failed me during my journey!

Really helpful. I’ve used this app to keep track of my progress since the beginning of my sobriety journey over three years ago. Addiction is never just one thing. Living a sober life means giving up destructive habits that led to the more obvious addiction. The various timekeeping clocks for various struggles address that. This app is reliable, easy to use, and very adaptable to whatever struggle a person is facing.

Love this. Great app that tracks recovery time from addictions. Also shows time and money saved. I’ve been using this app for years, since back when I had to keep resetting the clock. So cool to see how far my recovery has come in numbers.

grateful. i searched for something free that felt accessible, simple to use. i’ve been blown away. the community is raw and supportive. i look forward to watching my clock roll forward, and appreciate the opportunity to support others. it’s encouraging, and i’m grateful. thanks, Parker! nicely done :)

A pat on the back. No matter how far I am in my journey, I always remember Nomo, and I redownload it and am reminded of how far I. MYSELF. have made it.
Thank you for making this app. I’ll have 5 years of sobriety this August.
Amazing. Highly recommend!

Take pride in Sobriety. Sobriety is often a thankless job, not many people often say “congrats” on quitting a substance that in their eyes you should have never been addicted to. Nomo has helped me keep track of my progress to the T and reminds to give myself a pat on the back !
nomo. it’s has been so helpful for me i’ve used it for 2 years now
Amazing app. The best straight forward app for being clean
Love it. Love it
Love. Simple app has helped me a lot
Clocks are great!. Clocks in this app are great!

Amazing!. 10/10 app, keeps me accountable and the dev does anything he can to do so as well. 

Had a bug, left a review, and dev fixed it within 2 weeks. Amazing!

11+ years of NOMO. I’ve been using NOMO for over 11 years now. 11+ years of sobriety for me! I’ve stopped counting the days and just count the years now. But sometimes, I enjoy looking at my sobriety clock and see the thousands of days that have passed since my last drink. I went years without looking at this app, and then thankfully when I opened it my time was still ticking away. Very thankful for that.
Best “days since” app. I’ve tried most and this is the best app to track recovery days, sobriety days or just days since your last anything. Thanks for making this app!

simple but effective. i’ve used this app for YEARS to help manage my addictions. i like getting daily reminders that help me to keep pushing forward, and being able to break down the clock into smaller increments helps my brain when i’m in a mindset where i am considering relapsing. thank you for creating this app!
Best app to help stay honest.. I couldn’t ask for a better way to help me stay sober than this app. Thank you for making this app.

Amazing app. It does what it says does. I had an issue and the app owner helped me resolve it.
App is great, owner is great
Super helpful and customizable. I’ve been using Nomo for almost 2 months now and I’ve really enjoyed it. It’s very helpful and has a ton of features. Thank you for creating and maintaining this!
Jereme’s review. This app is great! It encourages me to stay on track!
great app. this app is great. easy to use and does what it was made for!!!
Great app. All around great app for tracking sobriety time and journaling. Lots of other nice little features. Great app
Works for me. Has helped me stay free of AI chat bots for almost 2 years. About to use it to quit drinking soda. Really appreciate the app being free and accessible.
Amazing. Literally great, free, no bugs, simple to use. Love it

Love this App!. "The therapeutic value of one addict helping another is without parallel". NA Basic Text

NOMO was developed by recovering people for recovering people which is apparent in its elegant approach to tracking progress in recovery for any addictive behavior with which someone is struggling. It works for newcomers and old timers alike and as of recently goes up to 50 years! I know this because I reached 29 years of recovery from alcoholism. I was having trouble opening that particular clock (I have four😉), I put in a help ticket and IMMEDIATELY got a response from Parker that they were in the process of increasing the day count limit from 28 years to 50. Yay!

And, when I needed to reset my day count in my 12-step food program, I got an encouraging message and the App tracks my resets. Day counts are important, but honesty always trumps it. I love the positive reinforcement and accountability that this App provides. It has become another tool to help me stay on the path.

Best Sobriety App. I love that this app serves the sole purpose of helping people come to sobriety. There are no ads, no subscriptions, just honest help and tools for your journey. Thank you for this amazing resource.
Nomo is Awesome. I love this app! Both for me and my girl!
Actually free 🥹. Fr. Free. Counter. Ignore the other apps, this is what you were looking for

Very helpful app!. Absolutely love this app. It’s super easy to use and has been a game-changer for staying accountable with my habit goals. If you’re serious about building consistency, this app helps you stay on track.
Nomo changed my life. Today I celebrate 8 years of sobriety. This app helped me so much in the beginning years and I still keep my tracker to this day. Recovery is possible ❤️
Thanks for helping keep me on track!. Easy to use and helpful in tracking milestones!
Very helpful. I stubble across this app almost in 2018. Paired with honestly working the 12 steps I've found sobriety.
Fabulous and helpful. This app is simple and helpful for me who just wants to track my days and get some daily encouragement. I also like that I can track my money saved.
NOMO APP. Love it!
Great app!. This app has helped me tremendously! Don’t forget to check out the resources.
Thanks for what you do. I will support independent apps like this because this guy’s testimony is amazing
Incredible!. Love this app! Very helpful and organized.
Love it. It’s a sweet spot for me and has multiple uses not just nicotine and alcohol. Nice set up well done!
I always come back to this app. I feel bad that this is free cus it’s my fav clock app and there’s lots of cute lil features. I try to donate when I can. ❤️

A general push toward consistency. This app was the first one I had found that served the purpose I was anticipating. Early one I would check it a few times a day. After I had accomplished my first year I was extremely pleased to see the clock turn. To this day, every time I log in I get a little tingle of accomplishment.
👏🏼👌🏼. Easy to use and pleasant to see information given to help motivate to stay sober.

great app!. I use it with my accountability partners. It’s been great. I feel their presence even more. I feel less alone. 

Might be good if there is also counter of doing good things.

Harm Reduction apps rock!. I love this app for tracking the various vices of which I am staying clear of these days. “The Rooms” are too much for me. This gives me a place to come and check out my current sobriety path without as much pressure to perform.
Awesome!. I feel like I’m accomplishing and defeating bad addicting habits.
Great app. Simple and easy. Just what I needed.. Really thankful for this app and its creator. You did a great job making a simple yet useful app that isn’t full of fluff.

Thank you for making it free. As a young addict, it is really discouraging that there are SO many apps that make you pay just to track your recovery and seek support. It’s as if people who can’t afford, or in my case, have any access to buying a subscription themselves don’t deserve to recover. Just the fact that it is free makes me WANT to give you money, though I cannot really do so :(

Great sobriety/ behavior/habit counter. I love the large variety of different clocks they offer. They track so many different things and I absolutely love it! They offer counseling and extra community support and encouragement!

The best timer app for any bad habits!. Not only do I think it’s very kind of the developer to release this as such an act of love and know it did not come easy. I’d love to see a widget option at some point but I try to squeeze in some donations because he deserves it!
Helpful app. Good for self monitoring

Game Changer. This app has become such an important part of my goals because it allows me to really see how far I’ve come whenever I check my clocks. Even when I fail, resetting them helps me to visualize a new start to my journey and it gives me motivation.
10 years sober. The app helps people take it one day at a time. I have recommended it as a path to sobriety to several people that successfully used Nomo as an anchor in sobriety.

Five Stars!. First of all how can you give anything less than five stars to this app? It was developed by a 100% volunteer and who is helping the community. I would give 10 stars! Or 100 stars! I do appreciate seeing the time clock for sobriety and the options for additional health. Thanks Parker.
Love it!. Simple, easy to use, I like that you can set multiple clocks for different things, and most of all I love that it doesn’t send you a million random notifications like most apps do.
Helpful reminder. I enjoy this app for a little reminder and encouragement when I need a little boost. Reminding we even on a bad day, I am winning at my addiction.

Simple clean effective.. This is an easy to use tracker of years months days minutes and seconds. 
Simple.
It does the job, and it’s free!. Does just what you’d think it would do

Another lifeline. How I stumbled onto this app was a final cry of desperation. No explanation beyond that. You are reading this review, so you know exactly where I was the day I found this app. I’m at day 2251 without drinking, and in no way would I have managed this if I didn’t have all the lifelines I could have for any given situation. This one? This one is that final net, that constant keeper of your time that you spend successfully navigating your life without whatever it is you are trying to rise above. For me it is booze. Anyhow. Out of those 2251 days, if one of those days was saved by this app, it’d be worth having a million times over. For me, it’s been there well over a dozen times in critical moments, moments when my other safety nets were unavailable or just not cutting it. Anyhow, good luck with your battle, this is a good tool to have in the armory. Truth.
Great app. Extremely simple and helpful app for tracking
variety,customization and efficiency. I enjoy the multiple clocks and interventions the app show cases and the pause of two seconds on the check in feature was a nice and very grounding touch
I’ve had it for years. I’ve been using it for years for many different things. It’s perfect and kept me focused even when I faltered
ummmazing. Never lost track of

Very Helpful. This is a very useful tool to help motivate and focus you on your recovery, the developer is very nice and supportive as well. Give it a try, you won't regret it :)
User. Very nice user friendly app.
<3. Love this app! Simple to use and track my status.
Great App!. This is a nice app to keep track of your sobriety mission. It’s good for other habits you’re trying to break.
micheal. beautiful mission and beautiful community, must download if ur struggling with any kind of addiction
Great App. Been using this for a really long time. Does what I need it to do, and has been rock solid.
Simple. Powerful.. I love app the give you exactly what you need and nothing else. That’s NOMO. I’ve been alcohol and caffeine free for over 4 years now. NOMO has been with me the whole time.
Accountability. Great for accountability each day I see that number go up makes me want to keep my streak more and more.

Problem i noticed + request. This app is great 100% 

Problem: The clock does not include Daylight Savings Hours. Not too long ago, the time "sprung forward", so now my clock is 1 hour behind what it should be.

Request: Can you make it so we can have custom types of clocks? I know that you can make the name of thr clock whatever you want, but I mean I want to make the actual type of clock specific things like: “Running” or “Daily Pages Read” and stuff, rather than just a list of options like “Alcohol”, “Drugs”, etc.
Great app. Keep you on track allows you to connect with others has access to activities to refocus and re-energize. It’s absolutely a great app!
Amazing. Literally best app for counting anything
the best. thank you for helping me track what matters.
Simple, clean, motivational.. Great app. Love checking in after years and feeling that internal pride of staying sober.
Amazing app. Great app, easy to use, been real helpful for me
Love this App! Super easy to use. Love this app, been using it since I quit drinking and now I use it to track other important dates and anniversaries as well. Highly recommend!
A life saver!. I was heavily addicted to 7OH but this app has helped me immensely figure out the formula
Wonderful App!. So helpful for tracking my goals!
Thank you. God bless you

I love you, Parker!. Thank you for taking the time out of your LIFE to bring this application to the needs of those who really need all the support they can get and not charging us a penny! Unlike other applications, I feel they are abusing people who need help to make some money… BUT NOT PARKER!! everyday I look forward to another day of sobriety add to my journey and this app helps with that. I love this app, I love you Parker, and again THANK YOU SO MUCH!

Every time. Every time I say No Mo and stop drinking I get this app. I tried another one this latest time and it was so clinical and ugly. Deleted it and downloaded Nomo again. I love the minimalist design and all the options within. My only suggestion is to make it easier to set a restart date. Too many steps.
Clocks. Great app..like the clocks!!
Love this app. A great free resource for anyone who wants to work on giving something up.
Great Motivation. Love this app! It helps keep me motivated and is even shareable with my support friends.
Love this app. Very great app for words of encouragement and to help others and yourself know you aren’t alone on your sobriety journey
great app. It has may great features and it allows you to set multiple diffrent clocks

Amazing. This app is very simple, yet constructed so well. Addictions are not a joke, and Nomo take any issue as serious as the last. Being developed by and independent dev gives it life and a sense of real understanding. Not a stupid cash grab with ads but a real tool to help people change their lives. Thank you nomo you are truly amazing :)
Love this app!. Been using Nomo for many years now. Love the design, the accountability and support options!
Sobriety Clock. The app is very helpful. Keeps you on track with tons of other services.
Motivational. Thank you for this app. It’s great, and does exactly what it says. I paid to get the add on app as well, to support.
Such a wonderful resource!. This app has genuinely has been so helpful in my personal journey. Having an app for quitting things that’s free has meant the world!
Love seeing my days add up!. Love seeing my days add up and the money I’ve saved. It’s encouraging to keep going!

Wonderful App, Truly must get!. Free app btw just a guy helping some people out with their issues. Another reason why I recommend this app is because there are also mini games to distract your mind. That part helps a ton even if i’m bored.
Helpful. I don’t I that I needed Nomo but I did! Sober 3+ years.
Keeps u in check. Great app, free, helps addicts what more could u want
Super helpful and thoughtful. I really appreciate this being a thing, idk why it was so hard to find an app like this!
The vice you want. Keeps you honest.👍🏼
Awsome!. Awesome app to track your sobriety. Many other features as well.
Best Clean Time App EVER!. This app is wonderful, well thought out, easy to use and Univesal for an abundance of Recovery Opportunities and more.

Excels on every level!. Beautifully designed Intuitive and fun user experience High appeal to the recovering addict Well organized Nomo is such a pleasure to use. I don’t know the developer personally, but I’m a fan of great design. It has sobriety clocks, as many as you want for whatever you’re quitting. It tracks your money, time and calorie savings. During cravings, it has Refocus activities to help you get through. It has had its occasional bugs, but no deal breakers and they’re eventually fixed. Being part of a sober community is essential in recovery. When you can’t be, this app has everything you need. Please buy Parker a few coffees and a dozen donuts. He’s doing a huge service with his talents. Service is the key to recovery, people! 🙂

Good With One Caveat. The ‘encourage’ little social section is FULL of people proselytizing… Fantastic app, but don’t go in there unless you want to see twenty posts a day where people give Jesus all the credit for their personal success.
Great app. Makes it so easy to remember important life events. What’s not to love?
Great Reminder. I love this as it is always a great reminder of how long you have been strong enough to say “Not today” after so long you don’t wanna start that clock over!!!
Works. Does what it should!
App suddenly stopped working.. Website isn’t loading either. Really needed this. Will find something more stable.

Parker is rocking in this world!. There was a bug in the workings and I sent him an email. He reworked the area and it’s better than ever now. He really cares, pays attention, and has the skills to pull off creating a truly supportive environment that is needed by so many..!
Best app for sobriety!. I love how it keeps track of how much money, calories and time I’m saving not drinking! Very motivating
Accountability Tool. It’s been a lifesaver
Have been using only this for years. Reliable, simple, easy. Hasn’t changed in years. The best!
Wonderful app. Helps keep me accountable
Helpful app. Been using this app to track sobriety for a few years. It’s reliable and easy to use. Really appreciate it!

Great free app. I love how it’s free and easy to use. I would love if they sent one notification a day of encouragement or something.

great app but might want to adjust notifs. i really like it and it works for me but i don’t enjoy the daily reminders since it’s always in my notifs reminding me of what i’m trying to quit would be super cool if i could set up milestone notifs instead like 30 days, 6 months, then annually. i just leave notifs off and use the widget so if i want to pay attention i can instead of seeing it daily in banners.
Fire app. Doesn’t pester you with subscriptions and can use without paying!!!🙏🙏🙏

Good. Helped me.

The little tidbits included like the mini distractions/games to recenter and refocus and connections to others on their journey have been most beneficial! Plus who doesn’t love seeing that ticker go up one everyday?!

Amazing. This app has helped me in so many ways and I know it can help many people to come love this app and what it does for people just out right amazing!!!!!
Great clock. This app is very easy to use and helpful.
Very helpful app. Been a great companion to remind me how far I’ve come. As of now, 1400 days and counting.

Quit Old Habits and Keep Track. The best part about this app you can have multiple topics for things you’re trying to quit and improve on. It also has a check in and each day you check in to help you stay on track and overcome those habits you’re working on to quit. I’m not a perfect person but definitely making a healthy change for myself and this app is here to make sure to keep me on track!.

Gamers, this is peak. No in-app purchases for any of the features, some mindfulness stuff to help with the urges, aesthetically pleasing and easy to use. You do have to sign in with an email, but I’m fairly certain they don’t use it for anything. Not even a newsletter.
Awesome App!!!. Love this app. Been using it for years and shared with many friends!!!

SUCH A GOOD APP!!!. I really don’t know what to say. It has everything I wanted in an app. I love that it lets you have multiple things you can work on because most are just drinking or self-harm. I also love that you can add a password, just absolutely amazing.

Really great. The only downside is that when the app loads, it does a flash that is hard on the eyes. Don’t know how to describe it, but it’s definitely a glitch! Other than that, I’m really appreciative for this app!
Reminds me how far I came. Love this app. I see how much time I have, how much I saved and connect with others

This app really helped me in early sobriety. I downloaded this app years ago when I was struggling big time. I can’t even say how many times I restarted my clock. Going back and reading my journal entries from that time is heartbreaking, but it reminds me of WHY I choose sobriety. I am now a little over 4 years sober but I still use the clock to look at my time every now and then.

Great app. I’ve tried to quit smoking at least a dozen times. Each time I failed, I would reset my clock. Now it has been over two years since I quit smoking. Sometimes I forget how long it’s been and I love to look at the nomo app to remind me just how long it’s been.
Life changing. Just do it. If you are looking at this you need something. This is a big start.
Accountability booster. Nomo has been such a great way to tap into the recovery community at your own pace, judgment free.
Not often. I do not make a habit of counting my sobriety days but every once in a while I get a kick out of the total. Good job.
Great App. Nomo is such a blessing! It helps me keep track of all types of dates!! Love it!!
Simple with options. Nomo’s simple interface and the options to set multiple sobriety clocks is great for dealing with internet addiction.
Free Community Support. Im new and oh so happy to be here.
Love this app!. Super easy to use and very functional, and very inspiring to keep me on track with my goals!
Great!!!. Do it I love it so far
Recovery pal. Great way to keep track of your recovery and how to fix habits. Love this app

Easy to use. Really easy app to use. I like how you can easily donate to the creators for a "cup of coffee " this app can be a lifeline to anyone who is struggling. The exercises in breathing are very helpful and can be done by oneself. Great idea.
Great App from a Great Guy. Great little app to help track milestones, and made by a real dude who is an A+ guy and super responsive. I don’t write reviews but this app is worth it.
Excellent. Love the journal, the activities, runs smoothly, you can interact with others if you choose. Highly recommend
Best app. Highly recommended. No ads, simple use, and it’s worked great. Best one out.
Almost 4 years of use. Thank you !
Works great. Works just as intended without being excessive with ads. Would reccomend.
Very helpful. It's very easy to use, love the unlimited clocks and find the check in option very useful

Great multi resource app and beautiful concept. I happened to stumble upon this app looking for something to help challenge myself with my health goals and bad habits. After downloading and reading the intro for what inspired this creation and the creators life/motive behind it, I was really moved. This is a genuine regular guy with a wife and kids who was looking for tools to help with his sobriety and created a multipurpose app that fit multiple things he was looking for, for his own journey. This is a passion project from someone who is simply looking to give back to the community and to help other people who are struggling, or are like me and are looking for a little reminder and help in accountability for my bad habits. This app has counseling, a journal section, a community board to help others who are struggling as well, or celebrate others sobriety milestones and wins, which I find so beautiful. There are book recommendations based on what bad habits or additions you struggle with, SO many resources for those in need, and it’s free which makes it accessible to everyone. Not to mention the fact that this is a free app that he runs by himself and only asks for donations if you’re feeling compelled to help the purpose behind this, which I am more than happy to contribute to. I recently lost a family member to addiction and seeing stuff like this warms my heart and reminds me there are really good people out there trying to make a difference still and help uplift others and create community to support one another. It’s really beautiful and I’m happy to have stumbled upon this app. Thank you to the creator for this awesome passion project that is helping so many people and creating resources for those in need.

PLEASE READ!!!!! TELLS YOU WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW!!!!!. So I just got this app and I love it.
